# azureacme_validation_binding (Data Source)

One DNS validation binding. Use `wildcards_allowed` in a `lifecycle { precondition }` so a forbidden wildcard fails the plan rather than the apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The precondition pattern from the quickstart.
#
# Wildcard is its own authorisation axis and is NEVER inferred from a name-scope
# grant: DNS-01 for *.api.example.com and for api.example.com uses the SAME
# challenge name, so technical control of the zone proves nothing that
# distinguishes them.

data "azureacme_validation_binding" "zone" {
  id = "example-com"
}

resource "azureacme_certificate" "api" {
  namespace    = "payments-prod"
  name         = "payments-api"
  dns_names    = var.dns_names
  key_vault_id = azurerm_key_vault.payments.id

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.azureacme_validation_binding.zone.wildcards_allowed || !anytrue([for n in var.dns_names : startswith(n, "*.")])
      error_message = "Wildcard names are not permitted by the example-com validation binding."
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `delegation_targets` (List of String)
- `healthy` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_checked_at` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `permitted_name_patterns` (List of String)
- `required_cname` (String) When unhealthy, the EXACT record to create.
- `wildcards_allowed` (Boolean) Wildcard is its own axis and is never inferred from a name-scope grant: DNS-01 for `*.api.example.com` and for `api.example.com` uses the SAME challenge name.
- `zone_id` (String)
